name: Parity WalletLibrary unprotected initWallet + kill
summary: WalletLibrary was deployed uninitialised and its initWallet() was reachable on the library itself, so anyone could take ownership and call kill(), selfdestructing the shared delegatecall target and bricking every Parity multisig pointing at it.
notes: This transaction deployed the shared WalletLibrary that the initialization and kill transactions later called directly.

Parity reports 513,774.16 ETH blocked across 587 dependent wallets. The ETH is valued using the retained incident-time DefiLlama price; Parity also reports additional inaccessible tokens, which are excluded because the post-mortem does not provide a complete token inventory or valuation.
The USD total excludes additional tokens that Parity reported as inaccessible but did not enumerate.
